content.text:
I wrote the solution to `benchmark/solution.ail`. Running `ailang run --entry main --caps IO,FS benchmark/solution.ail` prints exactly `Order: Widget = $60`.

How the effects line up:
- **`calculateTotal`** is a `pure func` with no effects.
- **`readPrice`** declares `! {FS}`.
- **`displayOrder`** declares `! {IO}`.
- **`processOrder`** calls all three, so it declares `! {IO, FS}`. `main` declares the same, since it writes `widget_price.txt` and then calls `processOrder`.

I deleted the `widget_price.txt` file that the test run created. The run has to start from the repo root, because running from inside `benchmark/` fails the module-path check (`MOD010`).
